description: Every file present in the pinned baseline tree is a protected surface. Deleting or modifying any of them requires a COMPLETE entry in .gamos-authorized-modifications.json (schema gamos/authorization@2 — structured TL approval, content-bound hashes; a truthy tl_approval alone is rejected). New files are additive and allowed; that is the default Gamos integration path. Governance control files themselves are hash-protected via baseline.controls (see scripts/gamos/governance-check.mjs v2 and ADR-0004).
control_integrity: sha256 of each control_files path is recorded in .gamos-architecture-baseline.json (controls) and verified on every push/PR/daily-schedule by .github/workflows/gamos-governance.yml, which itself pins sha256 of the baseline file (trust anchor, ADR-0004). Changing a control file requires scripts/gamos/governance-rebaseline.mjs, a complete authorization entry, and a TL-reviewed PR (CODEOWNERS + branch rulesets).

hard_requirements.notes: Existence of these files is necessary, not sufficient: operational preservation of every feature is tracked in docs/gamos/FEATURE-PRESERVATION-MATRIX.md. Control files are additionally hash-bound (control_files above).
